The Audio of the video will be omitted.

## CLI flag

```text
--muted
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#muted)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#muted)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#muted)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#muted)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#muted)
- [`canRenderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/can-render-media-on-web#muted)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#muted)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setMuted(true);
```
